# AV-HuBERT × AI-SPEAK — Python dependencies (Linux / CUDA).
# This is the authoritative list used to build the training environment on a
# Linux/CUDA GPU machine. setup_env.sh installs from this file.
#
# torch is the CUDA 11.7 build; install with the PyTorch index:
#   pip install -r env/requirements.txt --extra-index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu117
#
# fairseq is NOT listed here — it is vendored under av_hubert/fairseq/ and
# installed editable by setup_env.sh (pip install --no-build-isolation -e .).

# --- core (install FIRST, before fairseq) ---
numpy==1.23.5
torch==1.13.1+cu117
torchaudio==0.13.1
torchvision==0.14.1+cu117

# --- preprocessing + model deps ---
opencv-python==4.9.0.80
sentencepiece==0.2.2
editdistance==0.8.1
scikit-image==0.19.3
python_speech_features==0.6
pydub==0.25.1
dlib
tqdm==4.69.0
sacrebleu==2.6.0

# --- build pins (fairseq legacy metadata) ---
Cython<3
setuptools<70

# NB: omegaconf==2.0.6 / hydra-core==1.0.7 are NOT listed here on purpose.
# Their legacy wheel metadata is rejected by pip>=24.1, so they must be installed
# AFTER downgrading pip (pip<24.1) AND after `pip install -e fairseq`. setup_env.sh
# handles that ordering explicitly.
